title: Tensor pullback reflects section generation
statement: Let $j:Y\to Z$ be any scheme morphism, $M$ an invertible module on $Z$ [def-sc-invertible-module], $N$ a module on $Y$, and $e:j^*M\cong N$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $\sigma\in\Gamma(Z,M)$ and $\tau\in\Gamma(Y,N)$ satisfy $e(j^*\sigma)=\tau$, where the pullback section is given by the tensor-pullback adjunction unit and restriction from $j^{-1}(Z)$ to the top open [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. For any $y\in Y$, if $\tau$ is a local free generator at $y$, then $\sigma$ is a local free generator at $j(y)$ [def-sc-section-generating-locus, def-sc-local-free-generator].

proof.text: Transport generation through the inverse of e. Uniqueness of left adjoints compares tensor pullback to the source library pullback, compatibly with the adjunction units. Transport generation through this comparison. Apply the source library exists_generatesAt_of_generatesAt_sum (Modules.FieldBaseChange) to the singleton family with coefficient one, obtaining generation of sigma at j(y). The proof of that source lemma uses the local coefficient criterion and preimage_basicOpen.

theorem tensorPullback_generatesAt_reflects {Y Z : Scheme.{v}} (j : Y ⟶ Z)
    (M : Z.Modules) [M.IsInvertible] (N : Y.Modules)
    (e : (tensorPullback j).obj M ≅ N) (σ : Γ(M, ⊤)) (τ : Γ(N, ⊤))
    (hστ : e.hom.app ⊤
      (((tensorPullback j).obj M).presheaf.map (homOfLE j.preimage_top.ge).op
        (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app M).val.app
          (op ⊤) σ)) = τ)
    (y : Y) (hτ : GeneratesAt τ y) : GeneratesAt σ (j y)
